text:
lucy: FYI customer Arclight reporting 401s immediately after onboarding. Console shows no API key in project

lucy: Provisioner returned success in UI but the API key never materialized. Customer says SDK calls -> 401.

lucy: Quick snippet from provisioner logs:
```
2026-03-16T14:02:11Z INFO claim-init tenant=arclight-prod request=provision-123
2026-03-16T14:02:41Z ERROR bind-timeout tenant=arclight-prod target-project=arclight-main err="timeout waiting for service account binding"
2026-03-16T14:02:41Z WARN rollback started
```

tanya: Can you paste org/project IDs + customer email? I want to check if the OIDC claim arrived before the project was created.

lucy: Org: arclight-prod, Project: arclight-main, Customer email: ops@arclight.ai. Ticket SUP-4321 created.

support-bot: Created support ticket SUP-4321 and linked to onboarding pipeline trace: https://console.redwood/sup/SUP-4321 :ticket: 

samir: Repro looks like the typical race where claim binder retries stop early. From logs it timed out after 30s. Can you get full provisioner pod logs? Use `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/provisioner --since=1h`

lucy: Pasted full logs to SUP-4321. I also saw a 503 from project-service right before the bind timeout.

kyle: Short-term workaround: create API key manually in console for arclight-main and attach to project. Steps: 1) Console -> Projects -> arclight-main -> Keys -> Create key (scoped to project). 2) Send credentials to ops@arclight.ai with rotation note.

lucy: Did that and sent creds with limited TTL. Customer tried SDK call and got 200 ✅ (they confirm).

samir: I'll escalate to eng-platform. Likely fix: make claim binder idempotent and extend retry window + backoff when project-service returns 5xx. Opening ENG-1456 and assigning to @samir.

provisioner-bot: Backfill job queued for tenant=arclight-prod job=bind-backfill-247111

tanya: Postmortem note: we should add telemetry for "claim bind retry count" and alert when >3 for a tenant. Also consider increasing bind timeout to 2m for new onboards.

samir: Agreed. ENG-1456 includes tests against transient project-service 5xx responses.

lucy: Marking support ticket SUP-4321 as resolved with workaround applied and engineering follow-up. Customer confirmed keys working and onboarding complete. :tada:

support-bot: SUP-4321 status -> RESOLVED. Linked ENG-1456 for platform follow-up.

kyle: Thx everyone. I'll schedule a follow-up sync with eng-platform next week to review mitigation timeline.

lucy: Closing this thread.
